label: Swipe Right? — Dating & Apps
notes: Swipe Right? — Dating & Apps: gameId swipe-right matches registry (export SwipeRightGame). Reworks old ModesEngine build onto shared v2 engine. 84 scenarios faithfully mapped from GDD 45 JSON: 6 cats (dating-now/meeting-safely/fakes-and-ghosts/date-with-respect/profiles-are-people/tools-and-help), 7 types (branch 19/strike-rewrite 15/sort 15/reflect 13/role-play 9/spot 8/match 5), 0% binary. Modern dating & app safety: meet safely, spot fakes/ghosts, rejection both ways, profiles are people. Practical safety NOT fear-mongering (public, tell a friend, own way home, video-verify); skeptical of fast love/money (romance scams); even-handed across genders/orientations. India: dating hidden from family->tell a friend; image-based abuse->cybercrime 1930/cybercrime.gov.in/1098/181 (reassureCats meeting-safely+fakes-and-ghosts+tools-and-help). binStyle: added disposable/draining->red; REJECTED 'real check'->green (would mis-color smart-screen's bad 'Not a real check'). Spot ids injected (8). Builds on g24/g40/g44.
